verdict.rationale: Base44 documents in-app AI agents that update records, trigger workflows and connect to tools, plus a Data page that lists tables and records. None of the evidence says the product analyzes the user's data to produce insights or suggestions. Agent actions, the plain Data page and bring-your-own AI API integrations are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
